metadata.paper_title: Identification of hypoxic macrophages in glioblastoma with therapeutic potential for vasculature normalization
metadata.source_pdf: paper title: Identification of hypoxic macrophages in glioblastoma with therapeutic potential for vasculature normalization; public accessions: NGDC PRJCA008116 / OMIX002713, GEO GSE194329, OMIX003593

reference_execution_units.original_method: 过滤低表达基因和异常细胞，并用 inferCNV 区分 malignant 与 non-malignant cells。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 过滤低表达基因和异常细胞，并用 inferCNV 区分 malignant 与 non-malignant cells。
paper_explicit_operations: Genes expressed in fewer than 5 cells were excluded.
Cells expressing fewer than 300 or more than 7,000 genes were excluded.
Cells with mitochondrial genes greater than 20% were excluded.
inferCNV was used to classify malignant and non-malignant cells.
expected_observations: 低表达基因和异常细胞被排除。
inferCNV 提供 malignant / non-malignant cell separation。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 使用 Harmony 缓解 batch effect，基于 2,000 highly variable genes 做 PCA，用前 20 PCs 生成 UMAP，并用 Seurat FindClusters 聚类。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 使用 Harmony 缓解 batch effect，基于 2,000 highly variable genes 做 PCA，用前 20 PCs 生成 UMAP，并用 Seurat FindClusters 聚类。
paper_explicit_operations: Harmony algorithm was used to mitigate batch effects across samples.
PCA was performed on the 2,000 top highly variable genes using RunPCA.
UMAP used the first 20 principal components.
FindClusters identified clusters on the first 20 PCs with resolution 0.4.
expected_observations: 样本 batch effect 被 Harmony 处理。
PCA/UMAP/FindClusters 生成细胞聚类结构。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 使用 Seurat FindAllMarkers 识别 Mo-TAM cluster-specific alterations。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 使用 Seurat FindAllMarkers 识别 Mo-TAM cluster-specific alterations。
paper_explicit_operations: FindAllMarkers was used to identify Mo-TAM cluster-specific alterations.
Selection criteria: fold change >= 1.5 and adjusted p < 0.05.
expected_observations: 每个 Mo-TAM cluster 有 cluster-specific alterations。
阈值包括 fold change >= 1.5 和 adjusted p < 0.05。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 使用 FindAllMarkers 识别 myeloid-specific alterations，即 myeloid cells 相对其他 cell types 上调的 genes。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 使用 FindAllMarkers 识别 myeloid-specific alterations，即 myeloid cells 相对其他 cell types 上调的 genes。
input_data: Myeloid cells and other cell types in hGBM scRNA-seq
paper_explicit_operations: FindAllMarkers was used to identify myeloid-specific alterations.
Selection criteria: pct.1 - pct.2 >= 0.3, fold change >= 2, adjusted p < 0.05, and expression in >= 50% of cells within a cell type.
expected_observations: myeloid-specific alterations 被独立识别。
阈值包含 pct difference、fold change、adjusted p 和 cell type 内表达比例。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 将 cluster-specific alterations 与 myeloid-specific alterations 取交集，构建每个 Mo-TAM cluster 的 core signature。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 将 cluster-specific alterations 与 myeloid-specific alterations 取交集，构建每个 Mo-TAM cluster 的 core signature。
paper_explicit_operations: A core gene signature of each Mo-TAM cluster was extracted by intersecting cluster-specific alterations with myeloid-specific alterations.
The core signatures were used for cell deconvolution analysis.
expected_observations: 每个 Mo-TAM cluster 获得 core gene signature。
core signature 来源于 cluster-specific alterations 与 myeloid-specific alterations 的交集。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 使用 MSigDB C2/C5 gene sets 和 GSVA，对 single-cell count matrix 计算 z-score，并用 FindAllMarkers 识别 cluster core pathways。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 使用 MSigDB C2/C5 gene sets 和 GSVA，对 single-cell count matrix 计算 z-score，并用 FindAllMarkers 识别 cluster core pathways。
paper_explicit_operations: Human C2 and C5 gene sets were retrieved from MSigDB using msigdbr.
GSVA v1.48.3 was run on the single-cell count matrix with kcdf=Gaussian and method=zscore.
FindAllMarkers identified core pathways for each cluster with adjusted p < 0.05 and log2 fold change >= 1.
expected_observations: 每个细胞获得 GSVA z-score matrix。
core pathways for each cluster were identified.

reference_execution_units.original_method: 用 marker 和 pathway evidence 解释 Mo-TAM clusters，重点关注 hypoxia response、glycolysis 和 proangiogenic features。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 用 marker 和 pathway evidence 解释 Mo-TAM clusters，重点关注 hypoxia response、glycolysis 和 proangiogenic features。
paper_explicit_operations: Hypoxia-TAM cluster showed upregulation of hypoxia response genes ADM, BNIP3, and CSTB.
Hypoxia-TAM was associated with enhanced glycolysis and proangiogenic features.
expected_observations: Hypoxia-TAM cluster 上调 ADM、BNIP3、CSTB。
该 cluster 关联 glycolysis 和 proangiogenic features。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 使用 SpaceRanger 将 reads 比对到 GRCh38-2020-A，生成每个样本的 mRNA count matrix，并将 Visium spot positions 与 paired histology images 对齐。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 使用 SpaceRanger 将 reads 比对到 GRCh38-2020-A，生成每个样本的 mRNA count matrix，并将 Visium spot positions 与 paired histology images 对齐。
input_data: Public hGBM Visium spatial transcriptomics datasets
paper_explicit_operations: Public hGBM Visium datasets were derived from sources listed in the Key Resources Table.
Reads were aligned to GRCh38-2020-A using SpaceRanger v1.3.0.
mRNA count matrices were produced for each sample.
Spot positions were aligned with paired histology images using SpaceRanger.
expected_observations: public hGBM Visium 数据被处理为 count matrices。
Visium spot positions 与 paired histology images 对齐。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 使用 Seurat 处理 SpaceRanger outputs；过滤 counts、genes 和 mitochondrial percentage 异常 spots；用 SCTransform normalization/scaling/regression；排除两个图像质量差的 samples。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 使用 Seurat 处理 SpaceRanger outputs；过滤 counts、genes 和 mitochondrial percentage 异常 spots；用 SCTransform normalization/scaling/regression；排除两个图像质量差的 samples。
paper_explicit_operations: Visium spots with counts < 2,000 or > 35,000 were filtered out.
Visium spots with number of genes < 500 were filtered out.
Visium spots with mitochondrial gene percentage > 20% were filtered out.
SCTransform was used with percent.mt, S.Score, and G2M.Score as regressors.
GBM5_1 and GBM5_2 from GSE194329 were excluded because of poor image quality.
After QC and filtering, 35 hGBM spatial transcriptomic cases were included.
expected_observations: 低质量 Visium spots 被过滤。
两个低质量图像样本被排除。
最终 35 cases 进入后续分析。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 用 hGBM scRNA-seq 中已注释 Mo-TAM clusters 估计 reference signature；donor ID 作为 batch category，训练 Cell2location model。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 用 hGBM scRNA-seq 中已注释 Mo-TAM clusters 估计 reference signature；donor ID 作为 batch category，训练 Cell2location model。
paper_explicit_operations: Cell2location v0.9.0 was used to integrate hGBM scRNA-seq data with Visium mRNA count matrices.
A negative binomial regression model estimated the reference signature of different annotated Mo-TAM clusters.
Donor IDs were regarded as the batch category.
Model training parameters: max_epochs=120, batch_size=2500, train_size=1.
expected_observations: Cell2location reference signature model was built from annotated Mo-TAM clusters.
donor ID 被作为 batch category。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 用 Cell2location reference signature model 分解 spatial transcriptomic mRNA counts，并估计每个 spot 中各 Mo-TAM cluster proportion。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 用 Cell2location reference signature model 分解 spatial transcriptomic mRNA counts，并估计每个 spot 中各 Mo-TAM cluster proportion。
paper_explicit_operations: The reference signature model was used to decompose mRNA counts in spatial transcriptomic data.
The proportion of each Mo-TAM cluster in each spot was estimated.
Cell2location parameters included training iterations=100,000, number of cells per location N=20, and detection_alpha=20.
expected_observations: 每个 spatial spot 获得 Mo-TAM cluster proportion estimates。
Cell2location decomposition 使用明确参数。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 使用 Ivy hGBM 四类 histology regions，由 neuropathologists 在 H&E 上标注，并用 QuPath 导出 GeoJSON 后映射到 spatial spots。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 使用 Ivy hGBM 四类 histology regions，由 neuropathologists 在 H&E 上标注，并用 QuPath 导出 GeoJSON 后映射到 spatial spots。
paper_explicit_operations: Four histological regions were used: cellular tumor, infiltrating tumor, peri-necrotic region, and peri-vascular region.
Histological features were manually evaluated by two experienced neuropathologists.
Annotations were assigned to each spot on H&E images using QuPath.
Annotations were exported as GeoJSON files and mapped onto spatial transcriptomic spots.
expected_observations: spatial spots 被赋予 Ivy hGBM histology region labels。
QuPath / GeoJSON 完成 H&E annotation 到 spot 的映射。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 计算每个 histology region 内各 Mo-TAM cluster 的 Cell2location-computed proportion mean score，并用 ComplexHeatmap 展示 histology-transcriptome assignments。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 计算每个 histology region 内各 Mo-TAM cluster 的 Cell2location-computed proportion mean score，并用 ComplexHeatmap 展示 histology-transcriptome assignments。
paper_explicit_operations: The mean score of Cell2location-computed cell proportion of each Mo-TAM cluster was calculated for each histological region.
Histology-transcriptome assignment results were visualized using ComplexHeatmap.
Results report that Hypoxia-TAM was preferentially localized in the peri-necrotic region.
expected_observations: Hypoxia-TAM preferentially localized in the peri-necrotic region。
其他 Mo-TAM clusters 在不同 regions 中呈现不同 spatial distributions。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 定义 core HRGs，计算每个 Hypoxia-TAM cell 的 hypoxia score，用 Pearson correlation 找 top positive/negative correlated genes，并与 Hypoxia-TAM DEGs overlap 得到 HPGs/HNGs。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 定义 core HRGs，计算每个 Hypoxia-TAM cell 的 hypoxia score，用 Pearson correlation 找 top positive/negative correlated genes，并与 Hypoxia-TAM DEGs overlap 得到 HPGs/HNGs。
paper_explicit_operations: Core HRGs were defined as intersections of Hypoxia-TAM upregulated genes and HARRIS_HYPOXIA.
Hypoxia score was calculated with AddModuleScore.
Pearson correlation was used between each gene expression and hypoxia score in Hypoxia-TAM cells.
Top 100 positive and negative correlated genes were retained.
Candidates were overlapped with Hypoxia-TAM DEGs to identify HPGs and HNGs.
expected_observations: core HRGs、HPGs 和 HNGs 被构建。
hypoxia score correlation 将候选 genes 与 Hypoxia-TAM 内部 hypoxia gradient 联系起来。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 使用 STRING 预测 core HRGs 与 HPGs/HNGs 的 interactions，用 DAVID 做 clustering / functional annotation，并用 Cytoscape 可视化。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 使用 STRING 预测 core HRGs 与 HPGs/HNGs 的 interactions，用 DAVID 做 clustering / functional annotation，并用 Cytoscape 可视化。
paper_explicit_operations: STRING predicted interactions among core HRGs and HPGs/HNGs.
Interaction types included Experiments, Databases, and Co-expression.
DAVID was used for clustering and functional annotations.
The gene interaction network was visualized using Cytoscape v3.10.0.
expected_observations: Hypoxia-associated genes 被组织成 interaction network。
DAVID 提供 functional annotation / clustering。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 从 hGBM-IDHwt-7 和 hGBM-IDHwt-17 抽取 1,000 Mo-TAMs，用 GENIE3、RcisTarget 和 AUCell 执行 SCENIC regulon analysis。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 从 hGBM-IDHwt-7 和 hGBM-IDHwt-17 抽取 1,000 Mo-TAMs，用 GENIE3、RcisTarget 和 AUCell 执行 SCENIC regulon analysis。
input_data: Mo-TAM cells from necrotic hGBM cases
paper_explicit_operations: SCENIC was used to infer regulons across Mo-TAM clusters.
1,000 Mo-TAMs were extracted from hGBM-IDHwt-7 and hGBM-IDHwt-17 with apparent necrotic areas.
GENIE3 identified co-expression modules between TFs and potential target genes.
RcisTarget performed motif enrichment.
282 regulons were identified.
AUCell scored regulon activity in each cell.
expected_observations: 282 regulons were identified。
每个细胞获得 regulon activity scores。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 使用 CellPhoneDB 分析 ECs 与 Mo-TAM clusters 之间的 intercellular interactions，计算 ligand/receptor average expression 和 cell specificity likelihood。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 使用 CellPhoneDB 分析 ECs 与 Mo-TAM clusters 之间的 intercellular interactions，计算 ligand/receptor average expression 和 cell specificity likelihood。
paper_explicit_operations: CellPhoneDB v2.0 was used to investigate intercellular interactions across ECs and Mo-TAM clusters.
Average expression of ligands and receptors in each cell type or cluster was generated.
Cell specificity likelihood for receptor-ligand complexes was calculated.
expected_observations: EC 与 Mo-TAM clusters 的 ligand-receptor candidate interactions 被计算。
每个 ligand-receptor pair 有 average expression / specificity likelihood 框架。

reference_execution_units.original_method: 交叉筛选 Hypoxia-TAM signature genes、human genes encoding secreted proteins 和 hypoxia response gene set。
reference_execution_units.method_intent: 交叉筛选 Hypoxia-TAM signature genes、human genes encoding secreted proteins 和 hypoxia response gene set。
paper_explicit_operations: Hypoxia-TAM signature genes were subsetted using hGBM scRNA-seq dataset.
Human genes encoding secreted proteins were included.
A hypoxia response gene set from MSigDB was included.
ADM was revealed as the only candidate.
expected_observations: ADM 是 Hypoxia-TAM signature genes、secreted protein genes 和 hypoxia response gene set 交集筛选得到的 only candidate。
